metadata.title: Sentinel AI Governance Stack v2.4 Enterprise AGI/ASI Control Catalog

controls.title: Board-approved AI risk appetite and accountable ownership

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The organization maintains board-approved AI risk appetite, prohibited-use boundaries, senior manager accountability, and emergency pause authorities for all material AI systems.

controls.title: Complete AI, agent, data, model, and compute inventory

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Every material model, agent, tool, data source, vendor dependency, and compute allocation is registered, risk-tiered, owner-bound, and linked to evidence.

controls.title: Default-deny egress and mediated tool use

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: High-agency systems execute only through policy-mediated tools, default-deny network egress, signed telemetry, and tested kill-switch paths.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Containment policies are backed by model-checked invariants for egress, actuation stop, self-modification prevention, and proof-witness confidentiality.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The institution can prove systemic-risk bands, Annex IV completeness, fair-lending thresholds, and incident-timeliness conformance without revealing private witnesses.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: All regulated AI lifecycle, control, proof, containment, and incident events are written to immutable logs with hybrid post-quantum signatures and deterministic replay support.
